name: Workplace: corporate
about: A head office or a professional or financial services floor (law, consulting, banking): more cabins and enclosed rooms, a client suite at the front kept apart from the working floor, a boardroom, records. In three parts: the Workplace: corporate typology (on the Workplace one), an office fit-out on an RCC shell, and the BuilderPluss standards with the Indian codes. 2.1.0: its walls, fences, railings, parapets, beams, doors and windows in the versions that say how they sit and meet (R156: justify, corner, priority, align), all as before until one is set.
